The FDA's Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee (VRBPAC) met on May 22, 2025 to recommend a monovalent JN.1-lineage vaccine composition. The CDC recommends a 2024-2025 COVID-19 vaccine for most adults 18 and older.

If you don't have health coverage and don't use discounts, you can expect to pay $200 or more for a COVID vaccine. And an administration fee may be added to the cost of your shot. You may be able to save on your COVID vaccine with a GoodRx coupon.
